finalMessage:
`slugify("Crème brûlée")` now returns `"creme-brulee"`. The test suite passes (2/2).

The cause: the function lowercased the input and then replaced every non-ASCII-letter character with a dash, so `è` and `û` became separators. The fix in `src/index.js` decomposes accented characters with Unicode NFKD normalization and strips the combining accent marks before the other steps run. Plain ASCII input behaves as before.

I also added an assertion for `'Crème brûlée'` to `test/index.test.js`. I did not commit anything.
